docsConsulted: node_modules/@base-ui/react/docs/react/components/radio.md (shipped with the installed 1.8.0 package; https://base-ui.com/react/components/radio.md returns HTTP 404 and `radio` is absent from llms.txt)

value.notes: The unique identifying value of the radio inside its RadioGroup. Documented as a required prop (value*).

nativeButton.notes: Root renders <span> by default to support enclosing labels.

disabled.notes: Inherits from RadioGroup when not set locally.

readOnly.notes: Inherits from RadioGroup when not set locally.

required.notes: Inherits from RadioGroup when not set locally.

dataAttributes: data-valid / data-invalid, data-dirty / data-touched, data-filled, data-focused (inside Field.Root)

renderProp.elementForm: render={<button />} with nativeButton + id, paired with <label htmlFor>; or the documented render callback that wraps a <button> in a <label> so the hidden input lands outside the label

controlled.note: Radio has NO value state of its own — selection lives on RadioGroup (value/defaultValue/onValueChange). Radio contributes only its value prop.

formIntegration.nameValue: Radio.Root renders a hidden <input type="radio"> carrying form/id; the submitted name comes from RadioGroup's name prop.
formIntegration.validation: required on RadioGroup (or inherited from Field.Root) participates in native constraint validation.

keyboard.keys: Roving focus is provided by the enclosing RadioGroup (internals/composite: ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Home, End, loopFocus defaults true). Radio itself adds no key handlers.
keyboard.focus: One tab stop for the group; arrows move selection/focus.

notableDifferences: React Aria has a single Radio component whose selection state lives in RadioGroup; same split here, but Base UI requires the radio's value prop as a mandatory identity.
isSelected/isDisabled/isReadOnly/isRequired map to data-checked / disabled / readOnly / required.
Indicator is a separate part that can be kept mounted for animation; React Aria renders a single element with render props.
This is the ONE primitive of the 18 with no page on the public docs site (404) and no llms.txt entry — the authoritative page ships inside the package.
